data.description: This spell-like ability functions like bestow curse, but can have one of the following effects: -12 to one ability score; -6 to two ability scores; -8 penalty on attack rolls, saves, and checks; or a 25%% chance to act normally. This ability is treated as a 6th-level spell.
data.name: Greater Bestow Curse
